name: Peekr VR
summary:
No unzipping. No converting. No copying.

ZIP, RAR, 7z, CBZ… open your comic archives straight from the folder. Peekr VR is a VR viewer for the comics, photos, and videos you already own — on your headset or NAS, on a giant screen, as close as you like.

OPEN ARCHIVES DIRECTLY
Reads ZIP, CBZ, RAR, CBR, 7z, and TAR with no extraction. Two-page spreads, auto page-turn, and unlimited zoom — lean right up to a favorite page and take in every brushstroke and line your favorite artist drew.

CONNECT STRAIGHT TO Y
